captures.name: overview
captures.title: Start here: is the fleet healthy?
captures.body: One control room for every coding agent you run. These tiles answer the first question before you touch anything — what is live, what is stuck, which machines are up.

captures.name: attention
captures.title: The only number that needs you
captures.body: An agent waiting on an answer stops making progress until you reply. That is why this count sits on the landing page rather than inside a list you have to go looking for.

captures.name: nav
captures.title: The nav is the whole app
captures.body: Six destinations, and you will live in the second one. Open Sessions.

captures.name: sessions
captures.title: Sessions — where the work happens
captures.body: Every run you have started, grouped by what it needs from you. The ones blocked on an answer rise to the top, so a long fleet still reads in one glance.

captures.name: start
captures.title: Starting one
captures.body: This turns a prompt into a running agent: pick the machine, the folder and the account, and it works in the background whether or not you keep the tab open.

captures.name: accounts
captures.title: Accounts — the credentials work runs on
captures.body: Provider accounts can be grouped into pools, and a session can draw from a pool rather than one fixed account, so one hitting a rate limit steps aside instead of stalling the queue.

captures.name: access
captures.title: Access — what may run work
captures.body: Machines supply the compute, and they join the fleet from here with a single enrolment command. If a session cannot find anywhere to run, this is the page to open.

captures.name: guides
captures.title: Now walk it for real
captures.body: That is every screen. The rest of the guides run inside the app and point at the real controls in order — read the fleet, connect an account, enrol a machine, start a session, follow it. Start with this one.
